result.summary: Independently read test/specs/REQ-047.md, test/letflow/engine/task_activation_test.exs, and the new REQ-047 describe blocks in test/letflow/engine_test.exs (diffed against main). All 5 REQ-047 acceptance criteria have runnable tests: AC1 -> insert_attrs/4 unit test + 'create/2 (REQ-047 AC1)' integration test; AC2 -> 'create/2 (REQ-047 AC2)' forced :actor_id-missing rollback test covering tasks/instance_projections/tokens/events; AC3 -> 4 explicit unit dispatch tests (START/END/EXCLUSIVE_GATEWAY/PARALLEL_GATEWAY) in task_activation_test.exs plus 4 explicit 'create/2 (REQ-047 AC3)' integration tests, one per node type; AC4 -> resolve_assignee/1 unit tests (present + absent + empty-group) plus 'create/2 (REQ-047 AC4)' integration test; AC5 -> cancel_pending_timers/2 doc-assertion test (SCH-03 + S6 named) plus 'create/2 (REQ-047 AC5)' integration test (COMPLETED status, zero tasks rows). No '@tag :skip' or 'TODO: implement test' found anywhere in the spec or test files (grep clean). No hardcoded secrets/connection strings (grep clean). Fixtures are per-test unique: provisioned_tenant/0 creates a fresh tenant + Postgres schema per test via insert_tenant!/unique_name (System.unique_integer), with on_exit cleanup dropping the schema -- no shared hardcoded IDs, matching the file's established REQ-045 pattern. Tests are self-sufficient: each test independently provisions its own tenant/schema and definition (active_definition!/2), async: false with per-test isolated schemas so there is no ordering dependency; AC5's coverage spans two files (case 6 doc-check + case 11 integration) but neither test depends on the other having run. Programmatically measured describe+test combined string lengths (regex-extracted describe/test pairs, script at /tmp/len_check.py) for both files: task_activation_test.exs max = 148 chars ('pending_task_nodes diff per node type (AC3)' + PARALLEL_GATEWAY test name); engine_test.exs new REQ-047 describe blocks max = 191 chars ('create/2 (REQ-047 AC4) -- assignee_ref naming a group with no members still creates a PENDING task' + its test name) -- both well clear of the 255-char ExUnit ceiling. Note: engine_test.exs as a whole (pre-existing, non-REQ-047 tests) has one unrelated describe/test pair at 245 chars ('create/2 -- hop-limit-exceeded (REVIEWER-flagged gap, WF02-R...)') which is NOT part of this TEST-DESIGNER submission and is flagged here only as a pre-existing risk worth a follow-up, not a gate failure for REQ-047.
